title: 2026-10-25 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much (Tsinghua University, KV 保留集应随注意力漂移动态重选，而重选频率要按样本自适应调节。)、OpenAttention (Sogang University, 1% 的 KV 读取率足够，前提是未读尾部用一个计数感知均值代理兜住。)、Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cros (Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, 逐层嵌入可按 token 共享单份码元组，用层特定解码器还原，百倍压缩仍保 97)、Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models (DualverseAI, n-gram 嵌入表存 4-bit 即可省 75% 显存并保留 99% 收益，省)、When to Follow the Teacher (University of Pennsylvania, 教师动作应按其对学生的反事实优势加权，而这个优势能从现成 rollout 里无偏)

highlights.name: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection
highlights.note: 视觉 KV 随注意力漂移动态重选，比 InfiniGen 高 1.6–3.8 ROUGE-L

highlights.name: OpenAttention
highlights.note: 1% 读取率保留 99% 稠密精度，尾部用计数感知均值代理兜底

highlights.name: Compiled Parallel RAG Control
highlights.note: LLM 控制编译成树形探测，策略精确等价、延迟降 35–47%
